  and an OpenBMC service processor, sold as the AIS800-64O. All ports are on the FRONT in TWO BANKS of

  lamps and a reset button share the right of the wall; two 3000 W supplies and FOUR fan trays are on
  the rear. Its twin edgecore/ais800-64d is the same chassis with a QSFP-DD800 wall - and the two walls
  are laid out differently, which is the whole reason this one was fitted from scratch: the 64D spreads
  sixteen columns on a single 24.019 mm pitch and puts one lamp on the post beside each cage, and this

comments: 'Arrcus lists Edgecore AIS800-64O-AF (NOS: arcos).

  Listed per: Arrcus Hardware Compatibility List (External), June 2026, for ArcOS 8.5 - page 2, under
  Switching (XGS), the row ''DCS560 / AS9817-64O''.


  64 x 800G OSFP800 AI and data centre 2RU switch on a Broadcom Tomahawk 5 with an Intel Xeon D-1713NTE
  and an OpenBMC service processor, sold as the AIS800-64O. All ports are on the FRONT in TWO BANKS of
  sixteen stacked columns, and the columns are GANGED IN FOURS - four shells of four columns per bank,
  with a 4.13 mm gutter between them. Two 25G SFP28 in-band management cages, an RJ-45 management jack,
  a USB 3.0 Type-A storage port, an RJ-45 console, a ToD jack, 1PPS and 10 MHz timing jacks, six system
  lamps and a reset button share the right of the wall; two 3000 W supplies and FOUR fan trays are on
  the rear. Its twin edgecore/ais800-64d is the same chassis with a QSFP-DD800 wall - and the two walls
  are laid out differently, which is the whole reason this one was fitted from scratch: the 64D spreads
  sixteen columns on a single 24.019 mm pitch and puts one lamp on the post beside each cage, and this
  one gangs its columns and puts two lamps in the legend row above them.


  Configuration `ac-f2b`: Dual 3000 W AC PSUs, front-to-back airflow - red tray bars and red PSU latches,
  which is the build the rear elevation and this model''s own rear photographs show. Rated 0-40 C at 1800
  m.


  Also sold or listed as: AS9817-64O, DCS560

  100G or 8 x 50G; and it takes 1 x 100G on 4 lanes of 25G NRZ.

  RJ-45 in twenty-four columns of two, ganged six and six and six and six, then four 10G/25G SFP28 uplinks

  RJ-45 pair, a Type-A USB storage port, STK M/S and Reset buttons and eight status lamps. TWO HOT-SWAPPABLE
  150 W AC SUPPLIES AND THREE HOT-SWAPPABLE FAN TRAYS on the rear, in either airflow. It shares its 438
  x 474 x 44 shell and its whole front face with edgecore/eps203.
